lastCompletedStory.title: Surface post-merge-stalled at boot + document operator recovery

openQuestions: Pre-existing (not introduced by this story): templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md carries an orphaned duplicate 'Do NOT delete the marker yourself... only removed by the next plan run (US-004).' paragraph right after the implement-blocked marker's correct closer ('...only removed by the next re-armed implement dispatch for that issue.'). The wording is stale/wrong for the implement-blocked marker (which is cleared by a re-armed implement dispatch, not a plan run) and predates this story; left untouched per surgical-changes scope. Worth a follow-up cleanup story.

templates/.gitignore does not list .cam-ship-stalled.json, .cam-plan-escalated.json, .cam-plan-preflight-failed.json, .cam-implement-blocked.json, or .cam-post-merge-stalled.json (only the repo-root .gitignore has these entries). Pre-existing gap noted in scripts/cam/patterns.md; out of scope for this story (no AC required it), flagging again in case a follow-up wants to close it.
nextStoryContext: US-004 was the last story in this PRD (CAM-174, branch cam/issue-174): all 4 stories (US-001..US-004) now have passes:true. This story added: (1) templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md boot-read item #11 for `.claude/.cam-post-merge-stalled.json` (fields: prNumber, completedSteps, remainingSteps, reason) plus a distinct opening-blocker paragraph (`⚠ post-merge stalled: PR #<prNumber> (merged, tag/prune/close pending) — <reason>`), explicitly read-only/never-delete, mirroring the ship-stalled prose; (2) synced the .claude/agents/ dual copy (verified byte-identical to templates/ both before and after this edit -- no drift this time) and regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts via `bun run embed-vendor` (embed-vendor:check clean); (3) docs/recovery-runbook.md new section (y) 'CAM-174: post-merge-stalled -- diverged local main after a squash-merge', documenting the git-reset--hard-origin/main-ONLY-when-subsumed recovery followed by manual tag/prune/close completion and marker removal, cross-referencing ADR 0025 and src/release/post-merge.ts's step vocabulary. No src/ behavior changed (docs/template-only story); typecheck, bun test (4142 pass), and the full check:all spine (coverage/debt-markers/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) all green with zero budget/ceiling changes needed. Next agent: with the PRD complete, expect a PRD_COMPLETE dispatch or a review cycle; there is no further story in this PRD to self-select.
